description: Find Medicare-certified home health agencies that serve a ZIP code (as reported to Medicare), or that have an office in a state or city, or by name, ranked by the CMS quality of patient care star rating (1 to 5 in half stars), patient survey (HHCAHPS) stars or name. Each result has both star ratings, the share of patients rating it 9 or 10 and who would recommend it, services offered (nursing, physical, occupational and speech therapy, medical social services, home health aide), ownership, phone and the ccn for home_health_ratings.

city.description: City of the agency office (needs no ZIP).

limit.description: How many agencies to return. Default 15.

min_stars.description: Minimum quality of patient care star rating (half stars allowed).

name.description: Agency name or part of it.

services.description: Only agencies offering all of these services.

state.description: State name or two-letter code (all agencies in the state, or narrows a ZIP or city search).

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code of the patient's home: lists every agency that serves it. Best for "near me" questions.

name: home_health_search
title: Find and rank home health agencies
